RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (rho chiGood : ℝ) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k}

  G.leftGood ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W ∧
    G.rightGood ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W ∧
      ↑G.leftGood < ↑G.rightGood ∧
        TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN G.leftGood) chiGood ∧
          TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN G.rightGood) chiGood ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reserveMinus < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reservePlus ∧
                (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)), ↑j ≠ G.leftGood → G.reserveMinus j = G.central j) ∧
                  (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)), ↑j ≠ G.rightGood → G.reservePlus j = G.central j) ∧
                    (∀ v ∈ {G.central, G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                        chiGood ^ 2 * ↑k ^ (-↑W.bridgeLength) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts v) ∧
                      0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G ∧
                        RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RelativeEndpointTa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RelativeEndpointTarget
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RelativeEndpointTa.value:
∀ (k N K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (l m : ℕ),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
        have muA := RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a);
        have tx := RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x;
        have dx := RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x;
        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount a l m x omega) - muA * tx =
            ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
              ∑ d : Fin k with d < x j,
                (↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega) -
                  RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d)) ∧
          ↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount a l m x omega) - muA * (tx + dx) =
              ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega) - muA -
                ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
                  ∑ d : Fin k with x j < d,
                    (↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega) -
                      RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d)) ∧
            ∀ (A : ℝ),
              0 < A →
                (∀ (v : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
                    |↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount v omega) - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts v| ≤
                      A * (√(RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts v) + 1)) →
                  |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount a l m x omega) - muA * tx| +
                      |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount a l m x omega) - muA * (tx + dx)| ≤
                    A * ((2 * √(↑k * ↑K) + 1) * √muA + 2 * ↑k * ↑K + 1)

  b < N →

      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
        ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
            ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
              Function.Injective e →
                (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                  ∀ (rows : Fin (N - b) → Fin K → Fin k),
                    RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                        (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                          ∀ (q : Fin (N - b)) (j : Fin K), TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j = rows q j)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) =
                      ((PMF.map TimeProfile.sampleRow (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)) rows).toReal

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ColdGeometryFromEm.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ColdGeometryFromEmpiricalTarget
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ColdGeometryFromEm.value:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T eta rho chiGood density : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < eta →
          0 < rho →
            0 < chiGood →
              0 < density →
                2 * rho * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta / 100 →
                  ∃ (xi : ℝ),
                    0 < xi ∧
                      xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) ∧
                        ∃ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
                          P.IsRegular xi 1 ∧
                            ∀ (epsilon : ℝ),
                              0 < epsilon →
                                ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                                  2 ≤ N0 ∧
                                    ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                      N0 ≤ N →
                                        ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) (hN : 0 < N),
                                          eta ≤ RiffleLowerV2.lambda1 cuts hN →
                                            RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN
                                                  (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) <
                                                RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta →
                                              TimeProfile.LocalGood cuts hN chiGood density rho 0 T →
                                                ∃ (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G :
                                                  RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T) P W),
                                                  RiffleLowerV2.WitnessSpec cuts hN eta rho chiGood W ∧
                                                    RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chiGood xi P W G ∧
                                                      1 - epsilon ≤
                                                        RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                          (RiffleLowerV2.ColdLocalization hN P W G)

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.GenericQuadrature.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.GenericQuadrature
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.GenericQuadrature.value:
∀ (k N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (T rho phi omega M : ℝ),
  0 < T →
    0 < rho →
      0 ≤ phi →
        0 ≤ omega →
          0 ≤ M →
            ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ),
              Continuous f →
                (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p q : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                      P.classify p = i → P.classify q = i → |f p - f q| ≤ omega) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
                        IntervalIntegrable (TimeProfile.cellMass μ P i) MeasureTheory.volume 0 T) →
                      IntervalIntegrable (fun (t : ℝ) => ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑(μ t))
                          MeasureTheory.volume 0 T →
                        ∀ (cuts : RiffleLowerV2.Targets.HorizonCuts k N T),
                          TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts ⋯ μ P T rho phi →
                            ∀ (r s : ℝ),
                              0 ≤ r →
                                r ≤ s →
                                  s ≤ RiffleLowerV2.horizon N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T) →
                                    |RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N
                                            (fun (j : Fin (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) =>
                                              f (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts ⋯ j))
                                            r s -
                                          ∫ (t : ℝ) in r..s, ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑(μ t)| ≤
                                      2 * T * omega + M * ↑P.cellCount * phi * T + 4 * M * rho +
                                        (4 * M * ↑P.cellCount * (T / rho + 2) + 6 * M) / TimeProfile.logScale N

  0 < μ →

      0 ≤ ε →
        ε ≤ 1 →
          2 ≤ m →
            Even m →
              (∀ (r s : ℕ),

                    |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
                            RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r * RiffleLowerV2.falling (Y ω) s) -
                          μ ^ r * ν ^ s| ≤
                      ε * μ ^ r * ν ^ s) →
                |(RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => 2 ≤ X ω ∧ 2 ≤ Y ω) -
                      RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision μ * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision ν| ≤
                  ε * (1 + μ) * (1 + ν) * Real.exp (μ + ν) +
                    3 *
                      (RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m μ + RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m ν +
                        RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m μ * RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m ν)

RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.name: RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec
RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N → (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) → Finset (Fin K) → ℝ → ℝ → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
    (xi alpha : ℝ) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) =>
  have C0 := RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D;
  have C1 := RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D;
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → D.count i l = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
          |↑(D.count i l) -
                ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l| ≤
            1) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
            0 <
              ∑ l : Fin k, if 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l then TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ^ alpha else 0) ∧
          C0.Nonempty ∧
            C1.Nonempty ∧
              ↑(Finset.image (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊)
                        C0).card ≤
                  2 + ↑I.card * Real.log (1 / xi) ∧
                C0.card =
                    ∏ i : Fin P.cellCount,
                      (RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i).factorial / ∏ l : Fin k, (D.count i l).factorial ∧
                  (∀ (b : ℕ), (RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b).card ≤ C1.card) ∧
                    (∀ (b : ℕ), (RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b).card = C1.card → D.binIndex ≤ b) ∧
                      0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D ∧
                        0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D ∧
                          ↑C1.card = ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D ∧
                            (∀ x ∈ C1,
                                Real.exp (-1) * ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D) < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ∧
                                  RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D)) ∧
                              ∀ x ∈ C0, ∀ (j : ↥I), xi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (eta rho chiGood xi : ℝ) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>
  have b := RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N);
  have ellp := RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G;
  have hp := RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType;
  have ht := RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.tailType;
  have h := RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G;
  have z := RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ cuts hN P W G;
  have g := RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts hN P W G;
  have Hrel := RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G;
  have M := ↑Hrel.card;
  have Y := RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G;
  have c := min xi (min chiGood (1 / ↑k));
  RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts G.ambient ∧
    RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) = ↑N ^ b ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) xi 2 G.tailType ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) W.theta
              (min (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) (RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) / 1000) G.prefixType ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) 2
                (min (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) (RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) / 1000) G.tailType ∧

  b < N →
    Function.Injective p.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
        ∀ (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ),
          Function.Injective w →
            ∑ i : Fin d, r i ≤ N - b →
              RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                  (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                    ∏ i : Fin d,
                      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount (w i) ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w i}.card) (r i))
                  (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
                RiffleLowerV2.falling (N - b) (∑ i : Fin d, r i) *
                  ∏ j : Fin K,
                    (∏ a : Fin k,
                        RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount p j a)
                          (RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a)) /
                      RiffleLowerV2.falling (N - b) (∑ i : Fin d, r i)

    PMF.map TimeProfile.sampleRow (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ConditionalCollisi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ConditionalCollisionStability
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ConditionalCollisi.value:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∀ (b0 : ℕ),
        ∃ (D : ℝ),
          0 < D ∧
            ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
              b0 < N0 ∧
                2 ≤ N0 ∧
                  ∀ N ≥ N0,
                    ∀ (k K b : ℕ),
                      b ≤ b0 →
                        ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                          ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
                            (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                            Function.Injective p.row →
                              0 <
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
                                (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                                  |RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                          (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                            2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card)
                                          (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) -
                                        RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)| ≤
                                    D * ↑N ^ (-1 / 100) *
                                      RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ComponentExpectati.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ComponentExpectation
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ComponentExpectati.value:

  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.ascentCount H (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π))) ≥
    ↑(Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) / 2 + ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) / 6 -
      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RelativeOrderIndep.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RelativeOrderIndependence
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RelativeOrderIndep.value:

    ∀ (τ : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          ∀ (i : Fin d), ∀ x ∈ A i, ∀ y ∈ A i, π x < π y ↔ (τ i) x < (τ i) y) =

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileTransferTar.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileTransferTarget
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileTransferTar.value:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T e rhoCeiling : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < e →
          0 < rhoCeiling →
            ∃ (chiPartition : ℝ),
              0 < chiPartition ∧
                chiPartition < 1 / ↑k ∧
                  ∃ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
                    P.IsRegular chiPartition 1 ∧
                      ∃ (rho0 : ℝ),
                        0 < rho0 ∧
                          rho0 ≤ rhoCeiling ∧
                            ∀ (rho : ℝ),
                              0 < rho →
                                rho ≤ rho0 →
                                  ∃ (phi0 : ℝ),
                                    0 < phi0 ∧
                                      ∀ (phi : ℝ),
                                        0 < phi →
                                          phi ≤ phi0 →
                                            ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k),
                                              RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
                                                ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                                                  2 ≤ N0 ∧
                                                    ∀ (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N),
                                                      N0 ≤ N →
                                                        ∀ (cuts : RiffleLowerV2.Targets.HorizonCuts k N T),
                                                          TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts ⋯ μ P T rho phi →
                                                            RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileIntervalErrors T cuts ⋯ μ e ∧
                                                              RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileMarginErrors T cuts ⋯ μ e

                    N0 ≤ N →

RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RoundedTypeTarget.name: RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RoundedTypeTarget
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.RoundedTypeTarget.value:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ C →
        ∃ (Ctype : ℝ),
          0 < Ctype ∧
            ∀ (T xi : ℝ),
              0 < T →
                0 < xi →
                  xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
                    ∀ (m : ℕ),
                      ∃ (Cround : ℝ),
                        0 < Cround ∧
                          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                            2 ≤ N0 ∧
                              ∀ (N K : ℕ),
                                N0 ≤ N →
                                  ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
                                    P.cellCount = m →
                                      P.IsRegular xi C →
                                        ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (I : Finset (Fin K)),
                                          ↑I.card ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                                            ∀ alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4,
                                              ∃ (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                                                RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D ∧
                                                  RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P I alpha
                                                    (Ctype * T * xi * Real.log (1 / xi) +
                                                      Cround * (Real.log (TimeProfile.logScale N) + 1) /
                                                        TimeProfile.logScale N)
                                                    D

RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData.noConfusio.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {k : ℕ} →
    {P_1 : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} →
      {t : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P_1} →
        {k' : ℕ} →
          {P' : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k'} →
            {t' : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P'} →
              k = k' → P_1 ≍ P' → t ≍ t' → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData.noConfusionType P t t'
RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData.noConfusio.value:
fun {P : Sort u} {k : ℕ} {P_1 : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {t : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P_1} {k' : ℕ}
    {P' : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k'} {t' : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P'} (eq_1 : k = k') (eq_2 : P_1 ≍ P')
    (eq_3 : t ≍ t') =>
  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {k' : ℕ} =>
    {P' : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k'} →
      {t' : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P'} →
        P_1 ≍ P' → t ≍ t' → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData.noConfusionType P t t')
    (fun {P' : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {t' : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P'} (eq_2 : P_1 ≍ P')
        (eq_3 : t ≍ t') =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {P' : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} =>
        {t' : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P'} → t ≍ t' → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData.noConfusionType P t t')
        (fun {t' : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P_1} (eq_3 : t ≍ t') =>
          ⋯ ▸
            RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData.casesOn t
              fun (count : Fin P_1.cellCount → Fin k → ℕ) (binIndex : ℕ)
                (k_1 : count ≍ count → binIndex = binIndex → P) =>
              k_1 ⋯ ⋯)
        ⋯ eq_3)
    eq_1 eq_2 eq_3

{k K : ℕ} →
  RiffleLowerV2.Word k K →
    (l m : ℕ) →
      RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) →
        ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) → Fin k → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K
RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (l m : ℕ) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m))
    (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (d : Fin k) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (↑↑j + 1)
    (List.Vector.ofFn fun (h : Fin K) =>
      if h = ↑j then d else if hh : h ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m then x ⟨h, hh⟩ else List.Vector.get a h)
